findings.passage: I strongly support our state's Voter ID laws.
findings.note: In her iVoterGuide questionnaire for the 2022 attorney general race, she answered 'Strongly Disagree' to the statement 'People should be able to vote without photo identification' and added this sentence. Exact questionnaire date not shown on the page.

findings.passage: In the Kansas Senate, I've voted to strengthen election security and prohibit private donations like "Zuckerbucks" to election offices. As Attorney General, I will aggressively investigate and prosecute voter fraud.
findings.note: Her answer to 'What laws would you propose to change present voting practices?' in the same 2022 questionnaire.

findings.passage: I strongly reject attempts by the far-left to smear conservatives as "racist" for supporting policies like requiring voter ID at the polls.
findings.note: From her answer on racism in the same 2022 questionnaire; she names voter ID at the polls as a policy she backs.
